notes: Packages have individual source commits and source-tree receipts. Windows/Linux and Tauri macOS use the fresh 2026-10-19 main CI build; their application/core trees are unchanged by subsequent packaging checks and documentation.
The iOS resource omission was repaired and the final signed IPA rebuilt; the first incomplete IPA is rejected and excluded.
UniApp cloud safe-mode completed after login; its delivered APK contains ARMv7/ARM64. Requested x86_64 was not produced by the cloud SDK and remains an explicit architecture gap.
The UniApp icon preparation command was added after packaging. Generated PNG hashes exactly match those used by the verified APK; application runtime sources and signed manifest were not changed.
Flutter macOS was rebuilt after removing stale, no-longer-declared native assets. All 14 shipped Mach-O images are universal; no stale objective_c framework remains.

Windows/Linux and alternative Mac implementations are candidates. Alternative Mac app bundles lack a complete application signature; an ad-hoc executable signature does not imply bundle signing or store readiness.
Apple IPA/PKG and Android APK/AAB signing were verified locally. Store upload, server validation, current-package installation/upgrade and real BLE remain separate gates.
No public Release, store submission, or website download claim was published. H5/App resource archives are excluded from this installer count.
